full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant, for the purpose of disposal of this application, are that opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 1075 of 2023 against the present petitioner (defendant No.1) and others before learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka praying for a decree of declaration of title to and recovery of khas possession of Ka schedule suit property with another declaration that City Jarip Khatian No. 2468 in respect of Ka schedule suit land was wrongly prepared and published in the name of defendant No. 1 and not binding upon the plaintiff.
